title: Ukraine's allies to meet in Berlin to rally support for Kyiv after Trump-Putin-Xi talks
summary: Ukraine's allies will meet in Berlin on Thursday, just hours after US President Donald Trump, Russia's Vladimir Putin and China's Xi Jinping participate in a historic summit in Shenzhen. The "Coalition of the Willing" summit comes as Europe backs Kyiv in the war against Russia and seeks a seat at the table of any future peace talks.
